text:
anya: FYI canary for indigo15b (int4) pushed an hour ago. Early signal: memory fragmentation + p95 token latency spike after sustained traffic (~2k rps for 2+ min). attaching quick logs.
leo: can you paste the canary config? batch/prefetch/max_new_tokens defaults?
anya: short config paste:
```json
{"batching":{"min_batch":2,"max_batch":24,"max_new_tokens":256,"max_tokens_multiplier":1.25},"prefetch":{"enabled":true,"slots":2,"balancer":"round_robin"},"eviction":{"threshold_pct":70}}
```
sasha: thanks. two quick hypotheses: (1) prefetch slots + round_robin -> slot hotness mismatch causing KV churn, (2) max_new_tokens=256 too high for typical prompts causing sustained large KV growth and late OOM-like tail latency.
jamie: +1. infra traces show repeated KV eviction + immediate re-prefetch cycles at ~t+90s. stack shows allocator spikes in slab arena.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary report: 3/10 nodes degraded, avg GPU mem used 73% -> 91% over 3m windows, p95 token latency 180ms -> 410ms post-degraded start.
leo: can we reproduce locally? anya do you have a repro prompt / driver? curl would help.
anya: repro curl (small loop):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/examples/generate -d '{"model":"indigo15b-int4","prompt":"<long conversation>...","max_new_tokens":240}' & done
```
anya: note: using long-conversation prompt with many prefixes (session-like) — that amplifies KV size.
sasha: quick mitigation to test: reduce max_new_tokens default to 96 for canary and switch prefetch balancer to "slot_health" (scores slots by recent reuse/evict ratio). also try prefetch.slots=1.
jamie: also try bumping eviction.threshold_pct to 85 so we avoid thrash, then enable slot_compactor to do low-priority compaction between requests.
leo: if we lower max_new_tokens we need to check quality regression on long-form tests. run golden prompts overnight.
anya: ran smoke: lowered to 96 + slot_health + slots=1 + eviction 85. results after 20m: p95 token latency down from 410ms -> 190ms, avg GPU mem stabilized ~68%, no node OOMs in canary window.
infra-bot: perf-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: p50 62ms, p95 190ms, tokens/s +12% stable; degraded nodes 0/10.
sasha: great. can we quantify quality delta? run subset of 200 long prompts and compute rouge/bertscore.
leo: I'll queue the eval job (job id q-7821). expect overnight run.
jamie: next steps: (A) keep canary with reduced defaults for 4h, (B) run slot_compactor continuous at low priority, (C) add a short-term perf gate: if p95>250ms for 5m auto-fallback to previous model variant.
anya: noted. I'll update rollout policy + add reproducer to the thread. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
leo: if eval shows >2% quality drop on long-form we revert, otherwise promote change as default for indigo15b-int4.
sasha: also add a telemetry tag to track per-session kv_size and slot_reuse_rate so we can tune balancer algorithm later.
jamie: logging note: please include allocator arena snapshots in next canary push so we can correlate slab fragmentation with KV churn.
anya: will do. dropping the raw log bundle here for those who want it: https://s3.redwood/internal/canary/indigo15b/1751234567/logs.tar.gz
